reviewContext.userProblem: The user says the controls pane buttons are 'rounded white buttons packed with no margin and look terrible' and asked for the whole application, not only the controls pane, to look solid and stylish with no rounded corners. The before screenshot is tmp/ui-style/before/ui-full-1440x900@2x.png. These native widgets are unstyled: Apply song, Enable MIDI, the editors/grid/roll tabs, the persistence and Visuals selects, the Choose File input and the Packages Proxy input. Leftover radii are .vact-icon-button 6px, .vact-light 50%, and 2px/3px in code.css. Spacing and headers are inconsistent (design section 1).
requiredOutcomes: One token file, editor/src/app/theme.css, defines --vt-* custom properties on :root (colors, spacing 4/8/12/16/24, type 11/12/13/14, UI and mono families, control heights, focus ring) with a pointer: coarse override block. index.html links it before app.css.

Every button, icon button, slot button, tab, select, input, file input (::file-selector-button), checkbox and range, popup, badge and meter computes border-radius 0 with appearance none and flat token styling, including hover, active, pressed, focus-visible and disabled states.
There is a primary (accent) variant for Apply song and Enable MIDI, and a danger variant for stop or hush per the design.

Separate adjacent controls are at least 8px apart and declared tight groups are 4px apart. Toolbar groups have separators, status text is separated from buttons, and panel padding and section headers are uniform.
Under pointer: coarse, interactive targets are at least 36px tall.
All component sheets (app, bind, params, code, midi, pkg, visual) are token-only.

A static vitest token check (6 tests) and a silent Playwright style test (Chromium plus WebKit, --mute-audio on Chromium only, no audio interaction) check radius, appearance, gaps, coarse sizes and the focus ring. The style test writes after screenshots at 1440x900 and 1180x820 coarse to tmp/ui-style/after/.
Behavior is unchanged: npm run check exits 0, the full vitest suite passes, and npm run build passes.

designDecisionsAndRationale: theme.css is linked from index.html instead of being imported by the mount modules. Custom properties resolve at computed-value time, so sheets injected later by the protected mount.ts files can still use the tokens, and no protected file changes (design 3.1).
Base element rules have zero specificity (:where), so the native look is removed globally while component sheets can still override (design 4).
The --vt-syn-* tokens equal renderer.ts GPU_TOKEN_COLORS, so DOM and canvas token colors match without editing the renderer (design 3.2 and 7).
The token names are fixed in design 3.2 and 3.3, so the four wave-1 plans can edit disjoint sheets in parallel (design 9).
The style test opens details.vact-samples by setting the property, never by clicking, so sample controls are covered without any interaction (plan review UIS-PR-1).
intentionalTradeoffs: The open <select> option list stays OS-drawn, because CSS cannot reach it in WebKit (design 2).

The SVG data-URI tokens --vt-icon-chevron and --vt-icon-check contain literal hex values. Custom properties cannot be interpolated into data URIs, so the static check exempts theme.css from the hex rule.

The open user questions UQ1 (accent hue), UQ2 (hush danger treatment) and UQ3 (global [hidden] rule) follow the documented defaults unless the user overrides them (design-docs/user-qa/pending-ui-style-questions.md).
The coarse folded rail is 38px against a 40px button (accepted residual).
supportedEdgeCases: Disabled Apply song (no code) uses the disabled tokens, not the accent.
Coarse pointer at 1180x820: every visible interactive target is at least 36px tall.
WebKit may return an empty getComputedStyle appearance, so the test falls back to webkitAppearance. WebKit also rejects --mute-audio, so that flag is passed to Chromium only.
The .vact-sample-map row is a flex row, while li.vact-bank stays block so that ul.vact-entries remains below the row.
The danger hover does not depend on source order (.vact-icon-button:hover:not(:disabled) is removed).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: .vact-sample-map appears only when a sample library is present. If it is absent from the served build, the recorded absence plus the CSS spec is the coverage.
Real .midi-devices labels appear only after MIDI is enabled. Coarse sizing for them is covered by a probe checkbox label.
Merge conflicts with wf/canvas in code.css and impl-plans/README.md are resolved at merge time, not in this run.
